parts.name: AvatarImage
parts.description: Loads the source off-screen and mounts the only once it has loaded, so a broken image never shows. It animates in and out with `data-starting-style` and `data-ending-style`.

dataAttributes.name: data-ending-style
dataAttributes.description: Present while the part animates out.

dataAttributes.name: data-starting-style
dataAttributes.description: Present while the part animates in.

parts.name: AvatarFallback
parts.description: Shown while the image hasn't loaded: before it does, when it fails, and when there is no image at all.

props.name: delay
props.description: Milliseconds to wait before showing, so a fast-loading image doesn't flash the fallback first.
